scope.audit_eval_labels: forbidden in this round; not read or re-scored

null.method: global row permutation of J_perp within ProbeFit; marginal distribution preserved

positive_control.signal_definition: random unit direction in J_perp, orthogonalized to [1, global33], then beta * signal added to the empirical residual plus Student-t noise
positive_control.oracle_gain_definition: MAE(t + beta*s) - MAE(t), i.e. the MAE cost of the planted signal that the control cannot see
positive_control.detection_rule: estimated Gain_CJ_control > 0 and estimated Gain_CJ_raw > 0; report magnitude recovery versus oracle

decision.required_seed_direction: both seeds have positive Gain_CJ_control and Gain_CJ_raw
decision.required_null_comparison: observed gain exceeds the 95th percentile of the permutation null
decision.no_reason_if: positive control passes but no stable real gain versus raw and null
decision.continue_if: positive control passes and real gain is stable versus raw, control and null across both seeds
